notes.title: Game Update - November 5, 2024
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where magic cards could not be selected.
 Fixed an issue where the magic attribute for the Decotine's Magic Class was incorrect.


Character Adjustments
Soul of the North Adjustments

 Passive skill now triggers after only 4 normal attacks at all star levels.
 Attack speed increases by 1% for each unit that dies.


Bhuj Adjustments

 Passive skill damage doubles after using the active skill (scaling as 2-4-8-16, etc.).


Guardian Archangel Adjustments

 Passive skill no longer converts attack power and skill strength. Instead, when the Guardian Archangel is on the field, all allies receive damage reduction.
 Using the active skill enables the next skill to deal additional damage. This effect can stack.


Light Elf Adjustments

 Each Light Elf will increase the maximum health of all characters. Multiple Light Elves will have cumulative effects.


Nekomata Adjustments

 Passive skill applies a “Sinister Mark” to the target. The number of targets scales with star level (4/6/8).
 Active skill damage increases based on the number of Sinister Marks on the targets.


Takemikazuchi Adjustments

 Soul Bond bonus is set to 1 at all star levels. The Thunder Arrow now fires an additional shot for every 20 Soul Bond layers.


Bond Adjustments
Holy Prayer Adjustments

 After a follower dies, instead of gaining an invincibility effect, they now receive overall damage reduction.

notes.title: Update Announcement September 2, 2024
notes.notes:
Bond Changes

 Wild Heart: Wild Heart minions gain a 30% damage increase when at full health and regenerate 10% of their energy per second.
 Flame of Destruction: When a Flame of Destruction minion dies, it adds one layer of Ashes to other Flame of Destruction minions. When Ashes exceed 6 layers, the minion gains a Destruction effect, with its maximum energy increased to 10 for 6 seconds.
 Whisper of the Wind: Critical hits apply a Silence effect to the target.
 Holy Prayer: When a Holy Prayer minion dies, it no longer heals other Holy Prayer minions. Instead, it grants invincibility to all remaining Holy Prayer minions.
 Arrow Rain: Arrow Rain no longer increases damage. Instead, each attack applies a See-through effect to the target. When the target reaches 50 stacks of See-through, it loses all physical and magical defense.
 Future Updates: Changes will be made to Empire, War Frenzy, and other similar skills.


Minion Rework

 Heavy-armored Little John:
Passive: When health is above 50%, gains Heroism, increasing attack power by 35%. When health is below 50%, gains Fearless, increasing damage reduction by 25%.
Active: Applies one stack of Bounty to all enemies. If in Heroism state, deals X fire magic damage to the target. If in Fearless state, restores X health.
 Archer Hundington:
Passive: Every 5th basic attack applies one stack of Bounty to the target. When attacking a target with Bounty, each stack grants 1 Silver Coin and removes the Bounty, granting one stack of Renown, increasing attack by 1%.
Active: Fires a Pursuing Arrow at the target, dealing X fire magic damage and applying 4 stacks of Bounty. Fires an additional arrow for every 3 stacks of Renown.
 Nightmare:
Passive: Attacks apply a Fear Mark to the target. When the Fear Mark reaches 10 stacks, it deals true fire damage and stuns for 1.5 seconds.
Active: Releases a Fear Fireball to all enemies, dealing fire magic damage and applying 5 stacks of Fear Mark. Nightmare can attack all enemies for the next 3 seconds.
 Two-headed Serpent Dragon:
Passive: Basic attacks hit 2 enemies and steal 1% of their maximum health per hit.
Active: Deals true damage based on the target's maximum health to two enemies. If the Two-headed Serpent Dragon's health is above 5000, it enters a berserk state, gaining 50% attack speed, 30% attack power, and skill intensity.
 Tyamat:
Passive: Gains 15% magic penetration for each enemy killed.
Active: Deals lightning magic damage to all enemies. If an enemy is killed by this skill, it will be cast again.
 Sariel:
Passive: Increases the skill intensity of the nearest allied units.
Alternate Active: (1) Fires Divine Punishment Spears at all enemies, dealing poison magic damage and reducing attack and skill intensity by 30% for 10 seconds. (2) Restores health to all allies and increases their attack and skill intensity by 30%.
 Future Changes: Further modifications will be made to Nekomata, Takemikazuchi, Light Elf, Guardian Archangel, Soul of the North, Bhuj, and others.

notes.title: V1.0.1.5 Mercenary Troop System Update
notes.notes:
New System Update
Opening the Mercenary Troop System

 After activating the Mercenary Troop in the town development, the Mercenary Troop function can be used in adventures.
 Training feature - it is possible to transplant a passive from one follower to another character.
 A single character can only transplant one passive, and the transplant cannot be changed. When a character participates in star promotion, the first passive that was transplanted will be retained.
 Recruitment feature - you can select the bond and quality (white, green, blue) to randomly get 3 followers. You can spend gold coins to purchase the randomly generated followers.
 Town development - Cultivate the Mercenary Troop, cultivating the Mercenary Troop can increase the number of training times each time you return to the town, the training price, and the number of recruitments.


Update Language Support

 Update English language support.
